title: Settings
subtitle: Make the dashboard yours: enabled modules, language, mood.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Turn each page of your navigation on or off. A disabled page stays reachable by its address — nothing is deleted.
modules.hiddenCount: {count, plural, =0 {All modules are enabled} one {# module disabled} other {# modules disabled}}

desc.pulse: The morning ritual: the essentials in 30 seconds.
desc.overview: The full picture — streams, revenue, audience, catalog.
desc.roster: Side-by-side view of the artists: health, profitability, valuation.
desc.streams: Performance by platform, territory and track, updated daily.
desc.market: Spotify France Top 200 shares by group, artist and genre — captured every morning, labels read from Spotify.
desc.revenue: All revenue, every source, finally readable.
desc.audience: Who listens, from where, and how they found you.
desc.algoposition: Where Spotify recommendation streams come from, and how to earn more.
desc.finances: Every euro invested and the net result, by artist, project and track.
desc.calculator: What your revenue could become in 6 to 24 months, given what you're preparing.
desc.valuation: What the catalog is worth, and why — transparent method.
desc.fractional: Simulate a fractional raise on future royalties, without selling masters.
desc.splits: Rights split for each track: who gets what, and who signed.
desc.contracts: Deadlines, rates, advances and recoupment, at a glance.
desc.rights: Author and neighbouring rights in France: estimated, paid, gaps detected.
desc.urssaf: Estimated social contributions, deadlines and quarterly filing.
desc.audit: The gap between what your streams should earn and what gets reported.
desc.day1index: One score, and the five things that move it up or down.
desc.copilot: Ask your question; the answer is computed from your figures.
desc.fans: Who really listens — and what to send them.
desc.discovery: The potential of unreleased tracks, measured before release.
desc.sync: The catalog exposed to supervisors — ads, film, TV, games.
desc.tour: Dates, attendance, live revenue: the whole live side in one place.
desc.catalog: Projects, tracks, metadata — the source of truth for the repertoire.
desc.team: Members, roles and permissions per module.
desc.importer: Drop a distributor statement: the dashboard switches to your real numbers.
desc.comparatif: Comparison vs competitors (From Day 1 internal use).

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: The mood applies instantly, across the whole dashboard.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your role shapes what you see: an artist only sees themselves, a structure sees its whole roster.
